perpBasis.note: Entropy quotes pre-IPO perps in market cap: “a price of $1 represents $1B of the company's fully diluted valuation”. After listing, the oracle becomes share price × a fixed fully diluted count ÷ 1e9, taken from the final 424(b) prospectus (or the last S-1/A) — for Anthropic, the “Total Class A and Class N Common Stock (As-Converted, Fully Diluted)” line, excluding the option and no-economic-rights shares. Entropy has not published that count yet, and S-1/A No. 2 does not print that line, so the site converts on its own 18.01B fully diluted count (S-1/A No. 2 p. 24); Entropy's eventual count may differ.
perpBasis.afterListing: Converts in place: io:ANTH keeps trading in market-cap units with the oracle pinned to ANT × the fixed count ÷ 1e9; it does not settle or delist. Three calendar days before an announced listing the oracle becomes a 1-hour EMA of the mark (“hyperp mode”). If the IPO is delayed or withdrawn it continues under the pre-IPO method.
